Home › GTA 6 GTA 6 Is Almost Here: Trade in Your Old Console and Save on an Upgrade at PayMore What is your old system worth? By Noah Hunter Posted : Oct 22, 2026 5:37pm UTC Add IGN on Google We are finally under a month away from one of the most anticipated pop culture events ever: the release of Grand Theft Auto 6. It's been over 13 years since GTA 5 was released, and a new entry is finally almost here. Similar to many of Rockstar's games, GTA 6 looks to push graphical fidelity in many ways. So, if you're excited for GTA 6 (who isn't?) you'll need one of the latest consoles. If you're still playing on PS4 or Xbox One, you will not be able to play, as the game will only launch on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. However, there's still time to pick up a new console, and trading in your old gaming system is a great way to make that transition more affordable. As you look for console trade-in benefits everywhere, PayMore is a great option. Earn $10 Store Credit When You Trade-In Your Used Console at PayMore PRESENTED BY: PayMore PayMore Level Up Trade-In $10 Credit 0 PayMore wants to turn your old console into upgrade cash ahead of GTA 6. Find a location near you. See it at PayMore Right now, electronics resale franchise, PayMore is offering a new Level Up program that gives you a $10 PayMore promotional credit in addition to your regular cash offer. This can be put toward a PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X, meaning you'll have everything you need to play GTA 6 . This offer lasts through November 20 at participating locations. You'll just need to check if there's a store near you first: Find Your Nearest PayMore Location Current-generation consoles likely aren't going anywhere for a long while due to the component shortage, so purchasing one today is not something you'll likely regret. With demand for essential components continuing to climb, too, there's no telling if current prices will hold. What Is PayMore? If you haven't heard of PayMore until now, it's a top-rated electronics buyer with stores across the U.S., specializing in purchasing your old smartphones, tablets, laptops, and of course, consoles. How it works Simply put, if you're looking to sell electronics, you can bring them to a PayMore store and get a free evaluation using real-time market pricing software, and walk out with cash. The store aims to keep the process transparent and fair, taking into account the condition, age, and market demand. It seems worth checking out as you explore your console trade-in options right now. Tips When Selling at PayMore 1. Bring your cables with you Bring along any cables, accessories, or the original box that came with your device, along with warranty cards or paperwork if you still have them. 2. Charge up first, if you can To save time, charge your device before visiting so they can test it quickly. If you can’t charge it or don’t have the charger, they'll do it for you in-store. GTA 6 is set to finally return to Vice City for the first time in a mainline GTA game since 2002, with dual protagonists Jason and Lucia caught up in a conspiracy that takes them across the city. We've already seen so many new features revealed , and there's sure to be dozens more discoveries once the game is out next month.
